name: New Palam VIhar
shortDescription: New Palam Vihar, Gurugram is a well-connected residential destination near Dwarka Expressway, offering modern homes, builder floors, plots, and independent houses. Its strategic location provides easy access to Delhi, major highways, schools, hospitals, markets, and commercial hubs.
longDescription:
New Palam Vihar, Gurugram is a growing residential locality strategically located near the Dwarka Expressway and well-connected to Delhi, Old Gurugram, and major business destinations. The area offers a mix of luxury builder floors, independent houses, residential plots, and modern family homes, making it suitable for both end-users and property investors.

With convenient access to major roads, schools, hospitals, shopping centres, markets, and nearby commercial areas, New Palam Vihar provides a practical and well-connected lifestyle. Its proximity to Dwarka Expressway further enhances connectivity towards Delhi, IGI Airport, New Gurugram, and other important parts of the NCR.
